description: Work out an invoice due date and early-pay discount from terms like Net 30 or 2/10 Net 30. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Parses Net N, D/N Net M, Due on receipt, EOM and Net N EOM. Returns due date, days until due or overdue, discount and deadline, the annualized cost of skipping it and reminder dates. Don't use this for late fees; use /v1/late-fee. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: paidpilot_payment_terms
title: PaidPilot Invoice API: POST /v1/payment-terms
